title: Solve a small linear system with pivoting
prompt: Implement solve(payload) for A*x=b. payload contains a matrix A and vector b. Return {"solution":[x0,...]}. A must be square with 1 through 8 rows and b must have matching length; otherwise return {"error":"shape"}. All entries in shape-valid inputs are finite numbers. Use Gaussian elimination with partial row pivoting: at column k choose the remaining row with greatest absolute column value. If that pivot magnitude is <=1e-12, return {"error":"singular"}. This absolute pivot rule is part of the task, including for inconsistent systems. Do not modify A or b. Tests avoid ill-conditioned cases whose solution is ambiguous at the grading tolerance. Absolute/relative tolerance 1e-7.
